acceptanceCriteria: check-host-package-versions.sh derives shipped paths from each package's files list (or an explicit list covering these), with a test case for a skills-only change.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 OpenCode 2 port (adapter 0.3.0) during the rc.2 adapter audit. integrations/opencode/package.json files lists mcp.example.json and skills, but script/check-host-package-versions.sh does not treat changes to them as shipped-file changes, so AHI-020 can miss a required bump.
